prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Photo Quality Assistant and Real-Time Pet Preview: Redesign pet adoption setup with an integrated photo previewer, live quality tips, and example illustrations to prevent creation glitches. (why: Adoption step drops conversion to 60.9% with 1017s mean time, and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or visual glitches.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Display Diagnostic Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop verification screen before completion that tests floating window permissions and desktop mascot rendering. (why: 3 support tickets noted pets failing to show on desktop or the app stalling, while home step mean time reaches 2336s.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Pet Controls Guided Flow: Replace static welcome with an interactive quick-start walkthrough demonstrating how to summon, chat, hide, and manage your pet. (why: Finish completion rate is only 64.8% (median 395s / mean 5815s) and support emails report confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
3: [choose_path, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection: Reorder onboarding so users choose and customize their pet before being prompted to sign in. (why: Asking for sign-in upfront causes initial drop-off (76.2% choose_path, 72.9% sign_in); letting users create their pet first builds ownership and motivation.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Visual Cards with Time Estimates: Add estimated completion time badges and visual path option cards to the path selection screen. (why: choose_path has a huge disparity between median time (8s) and mean time (514s), showing prolonged confusion for a subset of users.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Waiting Tips Carousel: Add an engaging tip carousel and visual timer during pet asset processing. (why: The waiting step has an extreme mean duration of 2336s, causing drop-offs when users think the app hung.)
6: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Stalling Recovery Prompt: Add auto-trigger hint delay and alternative sign-in assistance options if sign-in fails or stalls. (why: 2 support tickets reported the sign-in screen stalling or failing to load.)
7: [adoption, incentive] First Pet Adoption Certificate Celebration: Enhance adoption certificate with mascot animation, achievement badge, and custom name badge. (why: Adoption drops to 60.9% completion; strengthening emotional milestone rewards encourages completion.)
8: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Sheet: Update final screen text with clear desktop shortcut copy and interaction cheat-sheet. (why: Finish step dropoff is high and 3 support emails complained about lack of clarity on how to hide or talk to pets post-setup.)
